achievements.name: Spirit of Rebellion
achievements.detail: Awaken your first Persona when the castle drags you into the Metaverse.

achievements.name: Thieves Assembled
achievements.detail: Form the starting crew of Phantom Thieves and leave the castle as a team.

achievements.name: Castle of Lust
achievements.detail: Steal the castle Palace's Treasure and force a change of heart in its ruler.

achievements.name: Museum of Vanity
achievements.detail: Clear the museum Palace and carry its Treasure out of the exhibit halls.

achievements.name: Bank of Gluttony
achievements.detail: Break into the bank Palace and take the Treasure from its vault.

achievements.name: Pyramid of Wrath
achievements.detail: Cross the pyramid Palace and secure the Treasure waiting in the tomb.

achievements.name: Spaceport of Greed
achievements.detail: Shut down the spaceport Palace and steal the Treasure from its launch complex.

achievements.name: Casino of Jealousy
achievements.detail: Win through the casino Palace and defeat its ruler in the last bout.

achievements.name: Cruiser of Pride
achievements.detail: Board the cruise-ship Palace and steal the Treasure that holds it together.

achievements.name: Mementos Cleared
achievements.detail: Ride the train of the public unconscious down to the deepest floor of Mementos.

achievements.name: Confidant Maxed
achievements.detail: Spend time with one Confidant until that bond reaches its final rank.

achievements.name: Stats Maxed
achievements.detail: Raise Knowledge, Guts, Proficiency, Kindness, and Charm to their highest rank.

achievements.name: Take Back the Future
achievements.detail: Finish the final Palace and see the Phantom Thieves' story through to its true end.
